D.comparison: Standard Revision of the Binet Scale

O.outcome_detail: correlation between Myers Mental Measure and Standard Revision of the Binet Scale

cells.quote: Requires only 20 minutes to give, and is said to show a correlation of .80 with the Standard Revision of the Binet Scale.
cells.note: The study reports an attributed correlation, not a treatment effect or superiority comparison; the phrase “is said to show” indicates the claim is hedged.

cells.quote: The mean inter-correlation with all other tests is 0.21 as compared to 0.47, the mean of the mean inter-correlation of all other tests.
cells.note: The study compares measured correlations among tests rather than randomly assigned learning conditions.

O.outcome_detail: correlation with achievement in school subjects

result.effect: not reported as a single value

cells.quote: The correlations of the Myers with the various measures of achievement are very low compared to others.
cells.note: Grades IV-VIII are included in the study; the entry relies on this reported comparison.
